SPX.label: S&P 500

SOX.label: Philly Semis
SOX.source: Polygon I:SOX 8/27 settled close, +2.33%, the best index on the board and the highest close since 8/18/26 on our own bars. And here is the number worth keeping in front of a client: NOT ATH and still 18.808% below the 6/22/26 record close 14634.72. The semiconductor complex just had its best day in weeks, on the back of a 106% revenue quarter from its largest member, and remains almost a fifth below its own June record. That gap is the honest measure of how much of the AI trade has already been repriced downward this summer

VIX.label: VIX
VIX.source: Polygon I:VIX 8/27 settled close, -4.60%, the lowest close since 8/14/26 on our own bars. Today's unsettled bar prints 14.48 to 14.50 and is deliberately NOT the tile value. US10Y.label: US 10Y
US10Y.source: TradingEconomics dedicated instrument page at 07:14 ET, +1.5bp, prior settle reconstructed from TE's own displayed change field. Down 6 to 7bp over the week per the Reuters rates wrap, so this morning's backup is a small give-back inside a week of falling yields. The 30Y is 5.209%, +1.3bp, and down about 8bp on the week. Yesterday's $44B 7-year auction is the fact to hold against the friendly weekly move: it stopped at 4.512%, the highest 7-year stop since December 2024, with a 2.50 bid-to-cover and indirect bidders taking only 60.8% against 70.1% previously

US2Y.label: US 2Y
US2Y.source: TradingEconomics dedicated page at 07:14 ET, +0.2bp - the front end held effectively steady into the Warsh keynote while the long end drifted up, so 2s10s STEEPENED to 44.9bp from 43.2bp on Wednesday. That is the shape you get when the market adds term premium and policy risk further out rather than pulling the first move forward. Cut probability is still exactly ZERO at every meeting through January 2027, so this curve is not pricing an easing cycle at all

WTI.source: NDTV Profit's Friday oil wrap, -0.29%. BRENT.label: Brent Crude
BRENT.source: NDTV Profit at -0.19%, corroborated by TradingEconomics at 88.28, -0.27%, and AP at 88.24. Disclosed rather than smoothed: Reuters and Bloomberg quoted Brent between 89.10 and 89.63, roughly a dollar higher, which is a different contract or CFD rather than a price disagreement - both also had it DOWN, so every source agrees on sign. The macro read matters more than the cent: Qatar's Prime Minister was in Tehran on Thursday and there was NO reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. Iran's stated preconditions are an end to the blockade, compensation and sanctions relief. Five ships transited on Aug 25, down from seven, and the IMO counts 70 incidents and 19 seafarers killed since Feb 28
